data.why: The upstream Location Engine requires a 285MB GHS Urban Centre Database GeoPackage tracked via Git LFS, which is not fetched in this environment, so it is replaced with a small bundled GeoJSON (same column schema) covering 5 cities; two other engine files are patched only to fail gracefully around two other Git-LFS-pointer model files (cloud_classifier.joblib, wildfire_risk_classifier.joblib) instead of crashing.

goals: Pick a city, delineate its area of interest, and scope a multi-engine Earth-observation analysis around it
Acquire a cloud-screened Sentinel-2 acquisition and inspect RGB imagery over the AOI
Derive terrain stability indicators (elevation, slope, aspect, hillshade) from a Copernicus DEM
Characterize recent climate conditions, extremes, and historical baselines from weather records
Classify land cover to quantify vegetation, built-up, and water fractions within the AOI
Synthesize a multi-hazard risk assessment (flood, landslide, wildfire, urban heat, wind) and an overall Earth Intelligence score to compare locations

review.summary: The tree accurately records the Home, Terrain, Weather and Land Cover steps at a sensible grain, with honest notes and mostly faithful screens. It leaves out the interface's actual payoff, Sentinel-2 acquisition, the multi-hazard risk assessment and the combined score, so it needs a satellite task and a synthesis phase, marked as not reached, before filing.
